name: Boltsteel Cut
description: Cut with a crackle of lightning running the length of the edge so the stroke lands with a snap.

name: Boltsteel Ward
description: Hold the blade in a guard wreathed in thin lightning that jolts any weapon that strikes it.

name: Boltsteel Pace
description: Step in a quick flicker of lightning so the body arrives a pace ahead of where it was seen.

name: Boltsteel Surge
description: Surge along a line of lightning and cut as the feet land so the flash and the edge meet.

name: Boltsteel Parry
description: Turn a blow off the charged flat and answer with a cut that carries the stored lightning.

name: Boltsteel Sense
description: Let a faint charge run along the blade and read from its pull where metal and hands are placed.

name: Boltsteel Rend
description: Cut with the blade alight so lightning and edge rend the guard together in one blow.

name: Boltsteel Aegis
description: Hold a net of lightning along the guard that shocks whatever strikes the shield.

name: Boltsteel Apex
description: Gather lightning along the edge and cut so the stroke lands and numbs the target's qi flow.

name: Thunderedge Verdict
description: streams: Swords + Lightning; draw the blade in a flash of lightning and let one cut and its thunder strike all foes in reach.

name: Windsteel Cut
description: Cut with a rush of air along the edge so the stroke lands with a sharp bite.

name: Windsteel Ward
description: Hold the blade in a whirl of air that turns light blows and slows heavy ones.

name: Windsteel Pace
description: Ride a puff of air under the heel for a light long pace with the blade steady.

name: Windsteel Thrust
description: Thrust with a spiral of air round the point so the pierce goes deeper and straighter.

name: Windsteel Surge
description: Surge on a rush of air and cut as the feet land beyond the target's guard.

name: Windsteel Parry
description: Brush a blow aside on a swirl of air and return a cut along the same current.

name: Windsteel Bind
description: Wrap the target's blade in a tight coil of air and hold it away from the body.

name: Windsteel Sense
description: Send a thin breath of air out along the blade and read the stir of every weapon it touches.

name: Windsteel Rend
description: Cut with a gale driving the edge so the stroke rends guard and cloth alike.

name: Windsteel Veil
description: Draw a veil of whirling air about the body and slip clear of the blow beneath it.

name: Windsteel Apex
description: Gather a gale along the blade and sweep it out in a wide arc that cuts every foe near.

name: Windcleaving Edge
description: streams: Swords + Wind; ride the gale into one cut that parts the air and the target at once.

name: Bodysteel Cut
description: Cut with the full frame behind the blade so muscle and sword qi drive the edge together.

name: Bodysteel Ward
description: Harden the forearm and the blade as one and take a blow on both without giving ground.

name: Bodysteel Pace
description: Drive off a braced leg for a heavy pace that carries the blade into reach.

name: Bodysteel Surge
description: Surge with the whole body behind the blade and cut as the feet land.

name: Bodysteel Parry
description: Take a blow on a tempered forearm and blade and cut back with the same turning of the hips.

name: Bodysteel Mend
description: Draw sword qi inward through the body to close the wielder's own cuts and bruises.

name: Bodysteel Hold
description: Pin the target's blade between the guard and a braced forearm and lock it there.

name: Bodysteel Rend
description: Cut with the full weight of the tempered body so the edge rends guard and bone.

name: Bodysteel Aegis
description: Spread the tempering of the sword through the whole frame to stand against a long assault.

name: Bodysteel Apex
description: Gather the strength of the tempered frame into one cut that lands and bears the target down.

name: Ironbody Edge
description: streams: Swords + Body Path; cut with sword and tempered body as one so the stroke lands and the frame holds firm.

name: Soulsteel Cut
description: Cut with the will of the wielder set into the edge as well as the qi.

name: Soulsteel Ward
description: Hold the blade with the will set firm so the guard does not give though the arm tires.

name: Soulsteel Pace
description: Step where the blade's soul leads so the foot finds the line without a glance.

name: Soulsteel Thrust
description: Thrust with will and qi together so the point goes where the wielder's mind has marked.

name: Soulsteel Surge
description: Surge after the blade's soul and cut as the feet land with will and edge in step.

name: Soulsteel Parry
description: Turn a blow with the flat and cut back at once on the blade's own sense of the line.

name: Soulsteel Sense
description: Let the blade's soul reach out and tell the wielder where each weapon and hand stands.

name: Soulsteel Bind
description: Lay a thread of will over the target's weapon and hold it against its owner's wish.

name: Soulsteel Rend
description: Cut with the blade's soul behind the edge so the stroke rends guard and resolve alike.

name: Soulsteel Aegis
description: Hold a shell of qi and will about the wielder that stands against many blows.

name: Soulsteel Lance
description: Gather will and qi into the point and loose a lance that pierces what a plain thrust cannot.

name: Soulsteel Apex
description: Cut with qi and will so the stroke lands and binds the target's own will for a moment.

name: Soulbound Edge
description: streams: Swords + Weapon Soul; cut with qi and the blade's soul together so the edge wounds the body and the will.
